जतु जतु, उ, n. (said to be fr. rt. जन्), lac,
a red dye or pigment formed by an insect analogous
to cochineal, a kind of gum; (ऊ, ऊस्), f. a bat.
—जतु-कारी, f. or जतु-कृत्, त्, f. a kind of fragrant
tree, = जतुका, (‘making lac,’ the lac insect forming
its nest in this tree.)
—जतु-कृष्णा, f. = पर्पटी.
—जतु-गृह, अम्, n. a house plastered with lac,
resin, and other combustible substances, (such a house
was built for the reception of the Pāṇḍava princes in
Vāraṇāvata by Purocana, at the instigation of Dur-
yodhana, the object being to burn them alive when
they were asleep after a festival. Warned, however,
by Vidura, they discovered the dangerous character of
their abode, and dug an underground passage by
which to escape from the interior. Next having
invited an outcaste woman with her five sons to a
feast, they first stupefied them with wine, and then
having burnt Purocana in his own house, set fire to
the house of lac and, leaving the charred bodies of
the woman and her sons inside, escaped by the under-
ground passage; see Mahā-bh. I. 5864.)
—जतु-
[]
गेह, अम्, n. = जतु-गृह.
—जतु-पुत्रक, अस्,
m. a man at chess or backgammon &c. (coloured
with lac).
—जतु-मणि, इस्, m. a mole, a natural
mark on the body.
—जतु-मुख, अस्, m. a kind
of rice.
—जतु-रस, अस्, m. lac, the dye.
—जतु-
वेश्मदाह, अस्, m. the conflagration of the house
of lac.
—जतु-वेश्मन्, अ, n. = जतु-गृह, q. v.
—जतू-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a man; (a various
reading for जातूकर्ण.)
—जत्व्-अश्मक, अम्, n. red
arsenic; [cf. शिला-जतु.]

जातु जातु, ind. (fr. जन् ?; cf. जनुषा under
जनुस्), at all, ever; possibly, perhaps; sometimes,
some day, once, once upon a time (e. g. किं तेन
जातु जातेन, what is the use at all of him born ?).
जातु is said to be used in connection with the
potential in the sense of ‘not allowing’ (e. g. जातु
वृषलं याजयेन् न मर्षयामि, I suffer not
that he should cause an outcast to sacrifice), or with
a present indicative to express censure (e. g. जातु
याजयति वृषलम्, ought he to cause an outcast
to sacrifice ?). In the Veda when जातु stands at the
beginning of a sentence the verb which follows re-
tains its accent. न जातु, not at all, by no means,
never; अपि जातु, perhaps, possibly; जातु-चित्, at
some time or other, some day, one day.
—जातू-
ष्ठिर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. eminently strong; (Sāy.)
always strong; or (अस्), m., N. of a man.

जातू जातू, Ved. (Sāy.) = अशनि, a thunder-
bolt.
—जातू-भर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. (Sāy.) armed
with the thunderbolt or nourishing created beings;
[cf. जातू and जात.]

जतुक, अम्, n. lac, see जतु; Asa Fœtida [cf.
जातुक]; (आ), f. lac; a kind of fragrant plant or tree,
= जतु-कृत्, जतूका, जनी, &c.; also = पर्पटी; a
bat; [cf. जतुनी, जतूका, अश्म-जतुक.]
जतूका, f. a kind of fragrant plant; a bat.

जातुक जातुक, the plant from which the
Asa Fœtida is obtained; (अम्), n. Asa Fœtida; [cf.
जतुक.]
जतुनी, f. a bat.

जत्रु जत्रु, उस्, उ, m. n. (said to be fr. rt.
जन्; in the earlier language m. and pl. only), the
continuations of the vertebræ; (in later Sanskrit) the
collar-bone, clavicle; ऊर्ध्व-जत्रु, the part of the
body above the collar-bone.
जत्रुक, अम्, n. the collar-bone, the clavicle.
जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born &c. See p. 344.

जात जात, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जन्), born,
brought into existence, brought forth, engendered
(e. g. मास-जात, born a month ago, one month
old; पुत्रो-जातः, a son only by birth, not by quali-
ties); grown, produced, arisen, caused, occasioned,
appearing, appeared, apparent, manifest; happened;
become, present; ready at hand, collected, stored up,
possessed, felt, experienced, inspired, with, affected
by, (often at the beginning of an adjective compound,
see examples below; also at the end of a comp., e. g.
पुत्र-जात, having a son born; श्मश्रु-जात, having
a beard; दन्त-जात, having teeth just growing);
(अस्), m. male issue, a son; a living being (used of
men and gods, but especially of the former); (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a race of the Haihayas; (आ), f. female
offspring, a daughter; जाते, O daughter! (अम्), n.
a living being, a creature; birth, production, origin;
race, kind, sort, class, species; a multitude or collec-
tion of things forming a class (e. g. कर्म-जातम्,
the whole aggregate of actions; सुख-जातम्,
everything included under the name pleasure); in-
dividuality, specific condition; [cf. Gr. γετος; Germ.
Kind; Lith. gentis.]
—जात-कर्मन्, अ, n. a
ceremony at the birth of a child when the navel
string is divided, (it consists in touching the infant's
tongue thrice with ghee after appropriate prayers);
delivery of a new-born infant.
—जात-कलाप, अस्,
आ, अम्, having a tail (as a peacock).
—जात-काम,
अस्, आ, अम्, fallen in love.
—जात-कोप or जात-क्रो-
ध, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged.
—जात-कौतुक, अस्, आ,
अम्, delighted.
—जात-कौतूहल, अस्, आ, अम्, being
eagerly desirous.
—जात-क्षोभ, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated.
—जात-दन्त, अस्, ई, अम्, (a child) that has a tooth
or teeth growing; having teeth.
—जात-पक्ष, अस्,
आ, अम्, whose wings have grown, possessing wings.
—जात-पाश, अस्, आ, अम्, having fetters, fettered.
—जात-पुत्रा, f. a woman who has borne a son or
sons.
—जात-प्रत्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, inspired with
confidence, confiding, believing.
—जात-बल, अस्, आ,
अम्, possessing strength, strong.
—जात-भी, ईस्, f.
‘fearful,’ N. of a woman.
—जात-मन्मथ, अस्, आ,
अम्, being in love, fallen in love, loving.
—जात-मात्र,
अस्, आ, अम्, just born, merely born; (अम्), n. as soon
as born, the instant of birth.
—जात-रजस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, having the catamenia.
—जात-रस, अस्, आ, अम्,
having taste or flavour.
—जात-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्,
embodied, having assumed a shape or form, beautiful,
brilliant, golden (?); (अम्), n. the form in which a
person is born, nakedness; gold; the thorn-apple.
—जातरूप-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, quite naked.
—जा-
तरूप-परिष्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned with gold.
[]
—जातरूप-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, golden.
—जातरूप-
शिल, अस्, m., N. of a golden mountain.
—जात-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, containing the word जात or any other
form derived from जन्.
—जात-वास-गृह, अम्, n.
the room in which a child is born, the room of a
lying-in woman.
—जात-विद्या, f., Ved. a know-
ledge of what exists or of the origin and nature of
all things.
—जात-विभ्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, flurried,
precipitate.
—जात-विश्वास, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
confidence excited.
—जात-वेदस्, आस्, m., Ved. an
epithet of Agni; (the meaning is explained in five
ways: 1. ‘knowing all created beings;’ 2. ‘possess-
ing all creatures or everything existent;’ 3. ‘known
by created beings;’ 4. ‘possessing वेदस् = riches;’
5. ‘possessing वेदस् = wisdom:’ other derivations
and explanations are found in the Brāhmaṇas, but the
exact sense of this word seems to have been very
early lost, and of the five explanations given above
only the first two would seem to be admissible for
the Vedic texts; in one passage a form जात-वेद
seems to occur.)
—जातवेदस, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to
Jāta-vedas; (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā.
—जातवेद-
सीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to Jāta-vedas.
—जात-वेपथु, उस्, उस्, उ, affected with tremor.
—जात-वेश्मन्, अ, n. the room in which a child is
born, the room of a lying-in woman.
—जात-श्मश्रु,
उस्, उस्, उ, one whose beard has grown.
—जात-श्रम,
अस्, आ, अम्, wearied, exhausted.
—जात-संवृद्ध,
अस्, आ, अम्, born and grown up.
—जात-सङ्कल्प,
अस्, आ, अम्, feeling a desire or passion for.
—जात-
साध्वस, अस्, आ, अम्, afraid.
—जात-सेन, अस्, m.,
N. of a man.
—जातसेन्य, अस्, m. a patronymic
from the last.
—जात-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, enamoured,
feeling love or affection for.
—जात-स्पृह, अस्, आ,
अम्, desirous, wishing for.
—जात-हर्ष, अस्, आ,
अम्, rejoiced, glad.
—जात-हार्द, अस्, ई, अम्, feeling
affection, becoming attached.
—जातागस् (˚त-आग्˚),
आस्, आस्, अस्, offending, sinning, committing fault; also
जातापराध, जात-दोष, &c.
—जातापत्या (˚त-
अप्˚), f. a mother, a woman who has borne a child.
—जातामर्ष (˚त-अम्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having the
anger roused, vexed, enraged, put in a passion.
—जाताश्रु (˚त-अश्˚), उस्, उस्, उ, weeping, shedding
tears.
—जातेष्टि (˚त-इष्˚), इस्, f. rites or sacrifice
performed at the birth of a child.
—जातोक्ष (˚त-
उक्˚), अस्, m. a young bullock, an ox.

जातक, अस्, आ, अम्, born, produced; (अस्), m. a
new-born child; a mendicant; (अम्), n. = जात-
कर्मन्, a ceremony performed after the birth of a
child; nativity, astrological calculation of a nativity;
(with Buddhists) a former birth of Śākya-muni and
its history; an aggregate or a collection of similar
things; [cf. चतुर्-जातक.]
—जातक-ध्वनि, इस्,
m. a leech.
—जातक-पद्धति, इस्, f., N. of a work
on nativities by Ananta; another work by Keśava.
—जातक-मुक्तावली, f. title of an astrological
work by Śiva-dāsa.
—जातकाम्भोनिधि (˚क-अम्˚),
इस्, m. title of an astrological work by Bhadra-bāhu.
जातायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Jāta.

जाति, इस्, f. birth, production; the form of existence,
whether as a man or animal, which is fixed by birth;
position assigned by birth; rank; family, race, lineage;
kind, sort, genus, species, class, tribe, caste; the cha-
racter or peculiarities of a species, the genuine or
true state of anything; reduction of fractions to a
common denominator; false generalization; a futile
answer, a self-confuting reply; a particular figure of
speech in rhetoric; a class of metres; a manner of
singing; a fire-place; N. of several plants, = Jas-
minum Grandiflorum; Emblica Officinalis; mace,
nutmeg; [cf. अन्त्य-जाति, एक-जाति, द्वि-जाति; cf. also
Lat. gens; Lith. pri-gentis.]
—जाति-कोश or जाति-
कोष or जाती-कोश, अम्, n. a nutmeg; (ई), f. the
outer skin of the nutmeg.
—जाति-त्व, अम्, n. or
जाति-ता, f. distinction or nature of caste or tribe;
special or generic property.
—जाति-धर्म, अस्, m.
the duty of caste, the law or usage of caste (e. g.
sacred study is the caste-duty of the Brāhman, fight-
ing of the Kṣatriya, &c.); generic or specific
property.
—जाति-ध्वंस, अस्, m. the loss of caste
or its privileges.
—जातिन्-धर, अस्, m., N. of a
[]
physician, = Śuddhodana in a former birth.
—जाति-
पत्त्री or जाती-पत्त्री, f. the outer skin of the nut-
meg.
—जाति-फल or जाती-फल, अम्, n. a nutmeg;
[cf. क्षुद्रजाती-फल.]
—जाति-ब्राह्मण, अस्, m.
a Brāhman by birth but not by knowledge.
—जाति-
भ्रंश, अस्, m. loss of rank or caste.
—जाति-
भ्रंश-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing loss of caste;
forbidden, improper; (अम्), n. doing an act pro-
hibited to a particular caste.
—जाति-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ,
अम्, fallen from caste, outcast.
—जाति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
of high rank, obtaining a high position.
—जाति-मह,
अस्, m. birthday-festival.
—जाति-मात्र, अम्, n. mere
birth, position in life obtained by mere birth; caste
only, but not the performance of the especial duties;
species, genus.
—जातिमात्रोपजीविन् (˚र-उप्˚), ई,
इनी, इ, or जातिमात्र-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ, (a Brāhman)
who lives only by his caste (without any sacerdotal
acts).
—जाति-माला, f. ‘garland of the castes,’ title
of a work treating of the different castes.
—जाति-
लक्षण, अम्, n. specific or generic distinction,
characteristic, mark of tribe or caste.
—जाति-वचन,
अम्, n. the idea of species or genus.
—जाति-वाचक,
अस्, इका, अम्, expressing genus, generic (as a name).
—जाति-विवेक, अस्, m. title of a literary work.
—जाति-वैर, अम्, n. natural enmity, innate or
instinctive hostility.
—जाति-वैलक्षण्य, अम्, n.
inconsistency, incompatibility, conduct or quality at
variance with birth or tribe.
—जाति-शब्द, अस्, m. a
word expressing the idea of species or genus.
—जाति-
सम्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from a good family,
belonging to a noble family.
—जाति-सार, अस्, m.
nutmeg.
—जाति-स्मर, अस्, आ, अम्, recollecting a
former existence, remembering one's condition in a
former life; N. of a Tirtha.
—जाति-स्मरण, अम्,
n. recollection of a former existence.
—जाति-स्व-
भाव, अस्, m. specific or generic character or nature.
—जाति-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, of low birth or descent,
void of caste, outcast, having a low position.
—जाती-
रस, अस्, m. gum myrrh.
—जात्य्-अन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्,
blind from birth, born blind.
जाति जाति. See col. 2.
जाती, f. a kind of jasmine.

जातीय, अस्, आ, अम् (used at the end of a compound
and by native grammarians considered as an affix),
relating or belonging to any species, genus, tribe,
order, family, race, &c. (e. g. अश्व-जातीय, belonging
to the horse-kind; वृक्ष-जातीय, belonging to
trees); [cf. वि-जातीय.]

जातीयक, अस्, आ, अम्, = जातीय; (e. g. एवं-जाती-
यक, of such a kind, of such a tribe or race.)
जातरूप जात-रूप. See col. 1.

जातुधान जातुधान, अस्, m. = यातु-धान,
a Rākṣasa, an imp, ogre or goblin.

जातुष जातुष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जतु), made of
lac or gum, covered with lac or with any artificial
form or condition of it; sticky, adhesive.

जातूकर्ण जातूकर्ण, अस्, m. (fr. जतू-कर्ण ?),
N. of an ancient preceptor; N. of a physician; and
of the author of a law-book; an epithet of Śiva.

जातूकर्ण्य, अस्, m., N. of several preceptors and
grammarians; N. of the author of a law-book.
